verdict.rationale: Evidence shows admin-facing permission controls (users & permissions API endpoint, admin ability to configure View permissions to see shared meetings, SSO/SCIM provisioning) and folder-based collaboration, indicating some sharing governance exists. However there's no evidence of private-by-default note settings or granular link/folder/workspace-level permission granularity described in depth. Missing for 10: explicit private-by-default note policy, granular link-sharing controls, workspace-level permission tiers, and independent/hands-on confirmation of admin visibility dashboards.
